items.title: Base change compatibility of extension by zero and pushforward along a finite morphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is the base change compatibility f_* of extension by zero equals extension by zero of g_* for a cartesian square with f finite and j an open immersion (statement lines 11611-11623). The proof is a complete stalk computation: the stems of the composite pushforward are computed by the finite pushforward formula and vanish at geometric points outside the open (proof lines 11626-11633); the restriction to the open is identified by base change compatibility together with the description of extension by zero (proof lines 11634-11638); and the characterization of extension by zero then forces the two functors to agree (proof lines 11638-11648). The non-formal content is the two computations. The claim is H2: a written stalk computation followed by a characterization.
